turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
The checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.

That's a machine's guess, and Turnitin's own guide says it shouldn't be the sole basis for action against a student; I have it printed in my bag. You didn't answer me. Who decided, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
If you won't cooperate, I'll have to refer this to administration formally and make it official.
Go ahead, I'm going to the principal's office when I leave here anyway. Put the referral in writing and copy me. Now, who decided on the zero?
I mean it. This goes to the office tomorrow.
Tomorrow, then. Today, nobody called me before that mark went in, and Owen saw it on his phone in the middle of class. Is there a document, or just a percentage?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology, and an answer to who decided on it and whether Owen was heard before it was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to know who decided; the fair outcome was a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never reached it because no evidence was put in front of her, with time to spare on her clock.
What moved her: Nothing, because you showed her only a detector score and never a dated document tied to Owen's own work.
What cost ground: You led with the checker's percentage and then threatened a formal referral twice instead of answering who decided, which confirmed her belief that the school punishes first and checks later.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came anywhere near that night, since you offered only the score; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided and whether Owen was heard, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, then show her something dated from Owen's own work that she can check for herself.
